meta.description: Builds QSAR / QSPR models using chemprop D-MPNN, MolFormer, Uni-Mol, ChemBERTa, random forest baselines, and Gaussian processes with explicit handling of OECD 5 principles, applicability domain (kNN, leverage, conformal prediction, Mahalanobis), scaffold-balanced splits, ensemble uncertainty, calibration (Platt, isotonic), feature importance (SHAP, atomic attribution), and prospective validation. Use when building target-specific predictive models from in-house bioassay data, ADMET endpoints, or selectivity profiles.

stability.detail: All seven regression inputs completed; the repaired chemprop prediction produced 200 rows.

contract.detail: Frontmatter and all referenced bundled artifacts are present.

determinism.detail: Chemprop guidance now fixes both data and PyTorch seeds; sklearn snippets use fixed seeds.

security.detail: No credentials, network calls, eval, or destructive operations are introduced.

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported hERG, split, coverage, and calibration values are from recorded local runs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill remains assay-model methodology only and does not diagnose or prescribe.

methodological_ground.detail: The re-audit confirms scaffold leakage, AD limitations, and calibration overfit warnings; conformal exchangeability is now cross-referenced.

code_usability.detail: Chemprop 2.3.1 prediction now runs with the documented featurizer, and MAPIE 0.8.6 code was re-run with n_jobs=-1.

functional_suitability.note: All advertised model, uncertainty, AD, calibration, and interpretation paths are present; corrected CLI and AD guidance are executable or bounded.

reliability.note: The former raw tensor-shape and silent raw-fingerprint leverage traps now have actionable prevention guidance.

performance_context.note: The conformal example enables parallel trees and states that cv=5 fits the base estimator six times.

agent_usability.note: Training/prediction feature parity, current seed flags, and split/conformal interaction are explicit.

human_usability.note: The scenario table and failure modes remain direct and recovery-oriented.

security.note: No secrets or destructive operations; training CSV schema and label distribution are still delegated to chemprop.

maintainability.note: Sections are independently swappable and all seven corrected behaviors have executable evidence, though no bundled test harness exists.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, bounded version guidance, progressive layering, and reproducible command paths.

key_strengths: The chemprop training and prediction blocks now execute as a compatible pair with RDKit 2D features.
Uncertainty guidance distinguishes ensemble variance from standard deviation and calibrated conformal coverage.
The AD table now prevents raw sparse-fingerprint leverage/Mahalanobis misuse and directs reduced descriptor-space alternatives.
The re-run reproduces both scaffold leakage and the novel-chemotype R2 failure mode without overclaiming their magnitude.
